analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold territory but remains in neutral range. MACD histogram shows improvement but no golden cross confirmed yet. 5-day low exceeding 20-day low suggests potential technical rebound, but low volume reduces confidence. Lacking conviction for trend change, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
